comment: Variation of menu-gold-selector-inverts-group-with-count: a Tourist drops her gold and an expensive camera, then opens the pick-up menu (pickup.c pickup() -> query_objlist(), PICK_ANY). "$" then "6$" leaves the gold deselected through wintty.c invert_all(), while the camera's inventory letter, which is no group accelerator, keeps toggle_menu_curr()'s count on a second press.
